workflows.name: Successful login with valid credentials
workflows.conditional_branch: Username IN [standard_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user] AND Password == 'secret_sauce'
workflows.on_success: redirects to Product Inventory page

workflows.name: Login attempt with locked_out_user
workflows.on_success: Shows error banner: "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out."

workflows.name: Login attempt with invalid credentials
workflows.conditional_branch: Username NOT IN [standard_user, locked_out_user, problem_user, performance_glitch_user, error_user, visual_user] OR Password != 'secret_sauce'
workflows.on_success: Shows error banner: "Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service."

workflows.name: Submit with missing Username only
workflows.on_success: Shows error banner: "Epic sadface: Username is required."

workflows.name: Submit with missing Password only
workflows.on_success: Shows error banner: "Epic sadface: Password is required."

workflows.name: Submit with both Username and Password missing
workflows.on_success: Shows error banners: "Epic sadface: Username is required." and "Epic sadface: Password is required."

workflows.name: View product details
workflows.on_success: opens Product Detail page for the product

workflows.name: Add product to cart (not in cart)
workflows.on_success: adds item to cart; button changes to Remove; cart_count increments

workflows.name: Remove product from cart (in cart)
workflows.on_success: removes item from cart; button changes to Add to cart; cart_count decrements

workflows.name: Add product to cart
workflows.on_success: adds product to cart

workflows.name: Remove product from cart
workflows.on_success: removes product from cart

workflows.name: Navigate back to Product Inventory
workflows.on_success: navigates to Product Inventory page

workflows.name: Open Shopping Cart via cart icon
workflows.on_success: navigates to Shopping Cart

workflows.name: Remove item from cart (row action)
workflows.on_success: removes item from cart

workflows.name: Continue shopping (action bar link)
workflows.on_success: navigates to Product Inventory

workflows.name: Begin checkout (action bar button)
workflows.on_success: begins checkout

workflows.name: Continue to Overview
workflows.on_success: proceeds to Overview step

workflows.name: Cancel returns to Shopping Cart
workflows.on_success: returns to Shopping Cart

workflows.name: Finish — complete order and go to confirmation
workflows.on_success: completes order and navigates to confirmation page

workflows.name: Cancel — exit checkout
workflows.on_success: exits checkout

workflows.name: Return to Product Inventory via Back Home
workflows.on_success: navigates to Product Inventory and clears the cart

workflows.name: User clicks Logout button to end session
workflows.on_success: ends session and redirects to login page; protected pages (inventory, detail, cart, checkout) are not accessible without logging in again

workflows.name: Reset App State button click
workflows.on_success: clears cart and resets in-app state (cart badge and add/remove button states) without logging the user out
